Home.eyebrow: Open source · multilingual · EU-hosted · GDPR by design
Home.manifestoTitle: Permettere all'utente di esprimersi nella forma più naturale possibile: la parola.
Home.manifestoBody: Nella sicurezza e nella ricchezza della propria lingua. Nessuna intelligenza artificiale, solo una tastiera che separa i pensieri da un'interfaccia pulita, amichevole e accogliente.
Home.limits: Up to 5 blogs per account · yourname.notturni.eu

language.title: Your language, first
language.body: Write and read in Italian, English, German… every post can carry its own translations.

noAi.title: No AI, no ads
noAi.body: A keyboard, a clean page and readers. Nothing is generated, ranked or sold.

notes.title: Notes that add up
notes.body: Footnotes, fragments, links and media become a bibliography for each blog.

portability.title: Yours to take away
portability.body: Markdown export, data portability and deletion — EU-hosted, GDPR by design.

HomePage.followingSignInTitle: Sign in to see who you follow
HomePage.followingSignInBody: Posts from the blogs and authors you follow show up here.
HomePage.followingEmptyBody: Follow a blog or an author: their new posts will show up here.

BlogsPage.title: Blogs on Notturni
BlogsPage.subtitle: {count} public blogs · listed only if the owner allows indexing

BlogAdmin.notOwner: You are not the owner of this blog: some actions are unavailable.

Overview.readsNote: Aggregated server-side, no cookies, no per-reader tracking
Overview.storageLine: {used} MB of {quota} GB · {images} images · {backups} Markdown backups
Overview.mediaCount: {count, plural, one {# image} other {# images}} in posts

Comments.policyRegisteredSub: Default. Published immediately, you can hide afterwards.
Comments.policyOpenSub: Anonymous comments wait in the queue before appearing.

Settings.title: Title
Settings.subtitle: Subtitle
Settings.defaultAuthor: Default author name on this blog
Settings.indexing: Allow search engines to index this blog
Settings.indexingSub: Also controls listing in the public directory
Settings.languagesNote: Readers see posts in their language first; untranslated posts fall back to the primary.
Settings.domainNote: CNAME → {host}. Certificate issued automatically. Disabled until subdomain routing lands.

danger.deleteSub: 30-day grace period, then erased. Type the slug to confirm.
danger.transferSub: To a current co-author. You stay as co-author unless you leave.
danger.pauseSub: Readers see a “paused” page; nothing is deleted; newsletter stops.
danger.exportSub: Markdown, images, notes, comments — ZIP link valid 7 days.

Settings.confirmBody: All posts, pages and images will be erased after a 30-day grace period. Followers are not notified. Type the slug to confirm.

vis.publicSub: Anyone can read. Listed in the directory if indexing is on.
vis.privateSub: Only you. No followers, no comments, no newsletter.

features.mentionsSub: Autocomplete and profile links in posts
features.fragmentsSub: Readers can save passages (max 15% of a post)
features.brainMapSub: Concept map from tags and [[references]] — experimental

Settings.aiCrawlingSub: Training and assistants: applied via robots.txt, a request for respect rather than a technical block

comments.membersSub: Default. Published right away, you can hide them later.
comments.everyoneSub: Anonymous comments wait in the moderation queue; requires the captcha configured on the instance.

Settings.deletedNotice: Blog pending deletion since {date}: it will be erased for good after 30 days.
Settings.pausedNotice: The blog is paused: readers see a waiting page, you keep working on it from here.
Settings.deletedToast: Blog pending deletion: you have 30 days to restore it
Settings.categoriesSub: Blog taxonomy: unlike tags, a post has at most one.

PlatformSettings.title: Platform settings
PlatformSettings.subtitle: Super admin only · every change is written to the audit register
PlatformSettings.thresholdNote: Above: blurred + queued. Fail-open if the service is down.
PlatformSettings.infraNote: Read-only here: values come from NOCT_* environment.
PlatformSettings.defaultLocaleNote: Used for visitors and new accounts; each user can override it in their profile.

Auth.loginIntro: Sign in with your email. The username is never used to sign in.
Auth.otpEmail: Enter the 6-digit code we sent you by email.
Auth.otpApp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
Auth.registerIntro: A space of your own to write, in your language. The username can be changed at any time.

FragmentsPage.title: Fragments
FragmentsPage.summary: {count} saved · {authors} authors · private to you unless made public
FragmentsPage.emptyBody: Select any passage while reading and choose “Save fragment” (up to 15% of the text). It stays private and is re-highlighted whenever you return.

Profile.title: Profile
Profile.subtitle: What readers see, what stays with you.
Profile.usernameHint: referenced by id — rename it freely
Profile.displayNamePlaceholder: Leave empty to use the username
Profile.mentionNote: Mentionable as @{username} in posts; renaming applies everywhere at once (existing @mentions in text stay as written).
Profile.signAsNote: An alias set by a blog (or by your role on that blog) always wins over this choice.
Profile.interfaceLanguageNote: Labels and menus only: it never changes the language of your posts.
Profile.followersTotal: {count} in total, adding those who follow your username and those who follow your blogs — including the ones using an alias different from your name.
Profile.followersPrivacy: Visible only to you: this is the only place where username and blog aliases are put together. Each blog and your profile publicly show only their own follower count, separately.
Profile.qrAlt: QR code to set up the authenticator app
Profile.qrManual: Can't scan the QR? Enter the code manually
Profile.qrHint: Scan the QR with your authenticator app, then enter the generated code.
Profile.downloadDataSub: Profile, owned blogs, posts and comments written, saved fragments, follows and API tokens.
Profile.deleteAccountSub: Sessions, API tokens, social links, fragments and SSO removed for good. Blogs, posts and comments already written remain, authored by "Deleted user". Not reversible.
Profile.gdprNote: Data is processed in the EU under the GDPR. The location used for the theme's sunrise/sunset is computed on your device and never sent to us.

PostPage.privacyNote: Reading position and highlights stay on this device unless you sign in. No trackers, no third-party fonts on the public pages.

CommentsSection.title: Comments
CommentsSection.policyMembers: Registered readers only. The author moderates before publishing.
CommentsSection.policyEveryone: Open to everyone. Anonymous comments are moderated before publishing.
CommentsSection.policyClosed: Comments are closed for this post.
CommentsSection.name: Name

BibliographyPage.title: Bibliography
BibliographyPage.subtitle: {notes, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}} across {posts, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}}, deduplicated. Each entry links back to the posts that quote it.

MediaPage.title: Media
MediaPage.subtitle: {count, plural, one {# image cited} other {# images cited}} across published posts. Every image carries its alt text; flagged images stay blurred until you choose to reveal them.

LinksPage.title: Links
LinksPage.subtitle: Every URL shared in the posts, grouped by site. Previews are fetched once by the server; your browser never contacts the third party.

Appearance.typographyHint: headings serif · body sans · max 3 fonts
Appearance.previewTitle: On writing slowly, in the margins of the night
Appearance.previewBody: There is a kind of writing that happens only after the house has gone quiet. It is not faster or better; it is simply less observed. The margin is where a text admits it is unfinished
Appearance.previewLink: and a footnote is the most honest sentence a writer can offer
Appearance.previewHint: Readers can still switch to dark: your palette defines the light theme, the dark theme uses the platform palette.
Appearance.previewHintDark: The dark variant is applied to public pages when the reader uses the dark theme.

PublicProfile.privacyNote: Counts show only what this author chose to make public. Anonymous followers are never listed.
PublicProfile.noPostsBody: Only posts signed with the username, on public blogs, appear here.
PublicProfile.noBlogsBody: Only public blogs that don't use an alias appear here.
PublicProfile.noCommentsBody: Approved comments signed with the username appear here.

AdminHome.title: Overview
AdminHome.servicesNote: Health of Postgres, Redis, RabbitMQ, MinIO and the moderation service will come with the platform overview endpoint.
AdminHome.usersDesc: Roles, activation and MFA of accounts.
AdminHome.moderationDesc: Hide or show posts of any blog.
AdminHome.pagesDesc: Editor of the main site pages.

Tokens.title: API tokens
Tokens.intro: They let you use the Notturni API without going through the editor or the dashboard, e.g. from scripts or external integrations.
Tokens.name: Name
Tokens.shownOnce: This is the only time the full value is shown: copy it now, it cannot be recovered later.
Tokens.confirmRevoke: Revoke this token? Whoever uses it will lose API access.
Tokens.emptyBody: Create a token to use the API from scripts or integrations.

BlogState.suspendedTitle: This blog was suspended by a platform administrator.
BlogState.suspendedBody: Reading and writing are paused, including for the owner, until the suspension is lifted.
BlogState.pausedBody: The author paused this blog: its content will be back when they reopen it. Nothing was deleted.
